name: Chaos Rush keeps a consistent distance whether the Felsworn is standing still or already moving (#9404)
contract: Chaos Rush Jump 802028 (SPELL_EFFECT_CHARGE_DEST) natively calls MotionMaster::MoveCharge at the fixed SPEED_CHARGE (42 yd/s) regardless of the caster's own movement. Spell::EffectChargeDest's forced PointMovementGenerator fights the caster's own live WASD movement/prediction, so a Chaos Rush used while already moving reports a shorter, variable displacement than the same cast while standing still ('always shorter than or equal to your distance if you use it while standing still'). This mirrors AscensionPyromancer.cpp's Flame Step fix (#6527): a stationary cast keeps the native MoveCharge lunge (10 yd, SpellRadius 13), while a cast made with a movement key already held skips the forced spline entirely and instead applies a brief run-speed surge (to SPEED_CHARGE) sized to the same 10 yd, leaving the caster's own client-steered movement in charge of the actual displacement instead of fighting it. The harness fixtures a held movement key without a client continuously steering position, so the discriminating evidence is that the moving cast neither forces a spline displacement nor leaves the run speed permanently raised, while the standing cast still lunges the full radius.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: the Felsworn knows Chaos Rush
Baseline distance to the dummy ahead
SETUP: the fixture starts at an unsurging run speed rate
Start moving forward, as auto-run or a held key does
DISCRIMINATING: the moving dash surges run speed toward SPEED_CHARGE instead of forcing a spline
Let the surge (10 yd / 42 yd/s) and any residual charge finish
DISCRIMINATING: the moving cast leaves the caster where the client is steering it instead of a shorter forced displacement
The dash restored the run speed rate it borrowed
SETUP: the Felsworn is standing still
Distance to the dummy before the standing dash
REGRESSION: a standing caster still dashes forward the full SpellRadius 13 (10 yd)
